title: MemoryGrantsGrantRequest
description: Issue a grant. Non-amplification: every issued dimension must be a subset of the granter effective coverage, otherwise NOT_AUTHORIZED (§6.5). Grant: admin with coverage subsuming the issued grant. Mutating op: requires idempotency_key (§7.0.5) and returns a MemoryReceipt whose result is a content-free summary (§7.0.2).

principal_id.description: Target grantee — a selector, never requester identity (§6.4).

capabilities.description: Open capability vocabulary. Core (documented, not enforced): capture, review, records_read, records_write, recall, profile_write, reflect, promote, transfer, admin.

context_ids.description: Optional placement-context restriction. Omitted = unrestricted; present = only the listed contexts plus shared visibility iff shared_access is true.

shared_access.description: Meaningful only with context_ids; MUST be omitted when context_ids is omitted (§6.5).

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen; unique within the dedup namespace (space_id, requester_principal_id, op, idempotency_key) (§7.0.5).
